items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: Billy Taylor and I, we got together and we bought one of those little kerosene stoves... we lived on those cars

ctx.x: -- no troubles. Oh, we got smart. We had two Pullman's and a baggage car. So Billy Taylor and I, we got together and we bought one of those little kerosene stoves, you know, and whenever we got into -- whatever town we're going to play in -- well, we lived on those cars, you see. We lived on them. So if we wanted steaks or anything, we'd go out, buy our steaks and whatever we wanted -- if we wanted some potatoes or anything. So we start cooking in the baggage car. So Duke found that out. So Duke come back there…
